dimensions.summary: Each managed Knowledge family is independently discoverable while stable page identity remains the only Reader-open authority.
Library browse, local search, locale copy and the durable page-type vocabulary agree without adding renderer or backend authority.
PIGE-KNOW-001 gains exact typed discovery evidence while PIGE-UI-003 remains partial for unrelated shell and Windows breadth.
The existing Library model and retrieval pageTypes contract absorb the feature without a new channel, service, index or durable format.
Existing UI, playbook, decision and trace owners contain the behavior without introducing another design document.

verification.evidence: Exact typed empty-query browsing, typed local search, stable page open and old-family result fencing pass directly.

verification.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:architecture-reset
verification.evidence: The existing bounded Library renderer owner compiles and builds without a new service or architecture-budget change.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: UI, playbook, accepted decision, acceptance evidence and semantic-claim owners agree on typed Knowledge discovery.

coordination.taskTitle: Bind exact typed Knowledge discovery in Library
coordination.compatibility: Existing page IDs, Library search IPC, retrieval indexes and Reader open semantics remain compatible; only exact existing pageTypes are selected.
